# Ray-AI — the Scoped Course-Administrator Copilot for ADCDA

*Buildable spec. Synthesized 2026-07-22 from five parallel design passes (agent charter/scope, Drive-ingest pipeline, residency/PII safety, course-admin features, MVP/GTM). Corpus and repo state independently re-verified against the live filesystem/git the same day the synthesis was written — see §0 and the reconciliation note at the end.*

---

## 0. Act on this today — independent of everything else in this document

Two things are already live and both were **re-confirmed by me right now (2026-07-22)**, not just carried over from the design passes:

1. **`~/.wingmen/cosem-ca-corpus/batch1819/`** (plus two files it generated at the corpus root: `_BATCH1819_INVENTORY.txt` and `_BATCH1819_MAP.md`, timestamped 2026-07-21) mirrors ADCDA's full Drive tree — `01_Admin/`, `03_Attendance_and_Results/` — the exact folders the 2026-07-14 `_DIGEST.md` said were unshared and PII-clean. The inventory file lists real namelist/results filenames (`ADCDA_18-19_trainees.xlsx`, BAPT namelist, theory results consolidated); the folder still sits at default `drwxr-xr-x` permissions, outside any silo, encryption, access log, or retention timer. I did not open cell contents, so exact PII presence is inferred from filenames/structure — but the inference is strong.
2. **cosem-adcda's git working tree** has `ADCDA_18-19_trainees.xlsx`, `SCDF_Theory_Questions.xlsx`, `SCDF_Theory_Test.docx` sitting untracked. I ran `git check-ignore -v` on them myself just now — **no output, meaning they are not gitignored**. One `git add -A` puts real gov-PII-shaped files into GitHub history permanently. `.gitignore`'s only pending change on disk right now is an unrelated `.vercel` line.

Neither of these blocks anything below — they're a 10-minute fix that has to happen **before any Ray-AI ingest job is pointed at that corpus**:

```bash
# 1. Quarantine (don't delete — Syed/operator may need this for the real
#    reconciliation work later; just get it out of any default read path)
mv ~/.wingmen/cosem-ca-corpus/batch1819 ~/.wingmen/cosem-ca-corpus/_QUARANTINE_UNCLASSIFIED_PII
mv ~/.wingmen/cosem-ca-corpus/_BATCH1819_INVENTORY.txt ~/.wingmen/cosem-ca-corpus/_QUARANTINE_UNCLASSIFIED_PII/
mv ~/.wingmen/cosem-ca-corpus/_BATCH1819_MAP.md ~/.wingmen/cosem-ca-corpus/_QUARANTINE_UNCLASSIFIED_PII/
chmod 700 ~/.wingmen/cosem-ca-corpus/_QUARANTINE_UNCLASSIFIED_PII   # 700, not 600 — a dir needs +x to traverse

# 2. gitignore fix (needs write access to cosem-adcda — flag to whoever has it
#    if this session doesn't)
echo -e '*.xlsx\n*[Tt]rainees*\n*[Nn]amelist*\n*[Mm]ilitary*[Ii][Dd]*' >> .gitignore
```

Both items are independent of the build plan below and cost nothing to fix now. Everything else in this document assumes they're done.

---

## 1. What it is

Ray-AI is Syed Nurrahman Shah's own embryonic workflow — a hand-maintained Drive folder plus a Claude session he re-points and re-explains each time — productized into a scoped, code-bounded course-administration copilot for ADCDA's NFPA 1010 program (Batches 18&19, 8 groups, ~250 trainees, 27 Apr–20 Aug 2026). It is not a new coding lane and not a second source of truth: it's a distinct fleet identity (`ray-ca`) with its own Telegram bot, a knowledge corpus ingested read-only from Syed's own "Ray" Drive folder, and a headless Claude brain that is filesystem-incapable of reaching anything outside its own scoped root. It beats the manual status quo on the exact axis that already broke it: the current workflow is hand-copied xlsx files that drift from the live app data — the documented origin of the still-open Group-1/4 Military-ID discrepancy — whereas Ray-AI reads one continuously-synced store and flags drift instead of silently propagating it; it's async from Syed's phone instead of a sit-down session; it accumulates scoped memory instead of being re-explained; and every skill it runs is a codified, repeatable Claude Code Skill instead of improvised prompting, with a fleet-auditable trail (`work_outputs`, bus-visible) an ad hoc session never had.

---

## 2. Architecture

```
┌─ SOURCES (read-only) ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Syed's "Ray" Drive folder             cosem-adcda app's own Firestore     │
│  (SOPs, skill sheets, question          `cosem-adcda-cb6d9` (authoritative │
│  banks, curriculum — course             namelist/exams/printables — read, │
│  KNOWLEDGE only)                         never re-derived; PII fields      │
│  folder-ID allowlist, verified           denylisted at the QUERY layer,    │
│  by parent-chain in code                 not just the output layer)        │
└──────────────┬──────────────────────────────────────┬──────────────────────┘
               │                                        │
               ▼                                        │
   nervous_system/ray_ingest.py                          │
   launchd, ONE-SHOT, ~30 min                              │
   changes.list + cursor → parse →                          │
   chunk → PII-classify → dedup                              │
               │                                                │
               ▼                                                 │
   KNOWLEDGE SILO — own named silo per TENANT-RESIDENCY-001       │
   (docs/data-store-registry.md), PII-clean by construction        │
   ray_documents / ray_chunks / ray_document_aliases                 │
   ray_sync_state / ray_ingest_log                                    │
   ray_doc_index (view) · search_ray() / get_ray_document() (RPC)      │
               │                                                        │
               └───────────────────────┬────────────────────────────────┘
                                        ▼
                ray-ca AGENT — nervous_system/ray_ca/handler.py
                fresh `claude -p` per message · CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN (Max)
                cwd = ~/.wingmen/cosem-ca-corpus/  (filesystem-scoped)
                .claude/skills/: Q&A · schedule+ripple · BAPT tracking ·
                name-reconcile · Director one-pager · Observations deck ·
                dept memos · onboarding-status
                boundaries.py: folder-allowlist · PII-sniff · draft-only ·
                ops-only · ID-reconciliation DISARMED (until Rung 4 gate)
                          │                              │
                          ▼                              ▼
              @cosem_ray_bot                  agent_messages bus row
              bot_channels row 'ray-ca'        → cc-orchestrator ONLY
              mode=ai-responder                (ray-ca holds NO credential
              deny-by-default: Syed's           for the hub's own channel —
              chat_id only                      cannot bypass the hub even
                          │                       under a bad prompt)
                          ▼ photo of a paper scoresheet routes to:
              pipelines/adcda-bot/  (EXISTING, unmerged branch
              feat/adcda-bapt-grading-engine — reused as a backend
              library, not a second bot Syed has to remember)
              OCR → table-reconstruct → roster-match →
              Sheets + Firestore upsert
```

**Drive ingest** (`nervous_system/ray_ingest.py`) is a one-shot script under launchd `StartInterval` (~30 min, `dev.wingmen.ray-ingest.plist`) — not a long-poll daemon; Drive content changes at human cadence, and a persistent daemon here is crash-loop risk for no benefit. Auth reuses the already-provisioned `GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS` (`~/.wingmen/keys/cosem-sa.json`), scoped `drive.readonly`. Discovery is `changes.list` + a `startPageToken` cursor (persisted in `ray_sync_state`, advanced only after a run fully succeeds), plus a weekly full-crawl reconciliation pass. **Zero new Python dependencies** — `google-api-python-client`, `google-auth`, `pdfplumber`, `pypdfium2`, `python-docx`, `openpyxl`, `python-pptx`, `tiktoken` are already in `.venv`, covering PDF (with Vision-OCR fallback for scans), DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, and native Docs/Sheets export.

**Source scoping is enforced in code, not trusted from Drive-share scope** — the exact assumption that just broke (§0). `RAY_ALLOWED_DRIVE_FOLDER_IDS=["1yJ452pKDhA82Z5FCwK13Y7Tu58yzUfje"]` (the real "Ray" folder), every file's parent-chain walked and verified against it before read. A concrete proof this isn't hypothetical: adcda-bot's own config already hardcodes a sibling folder in the same Drive tree, `1Yra-M-y3EiTcI5p8k9eNoCqSGsWiJGW5` (BAPT/Results) — one folder over from "Ray," and exactly what must stay denylisted. A content-level PII regex sniff runs as defense-in-depth on top of the folder allowlist, before persistence.

**Knowledge layer**: structural-boundary chunking (headings/rows/slides, tiktoken sub-split ~300–500 tokens, 15% overlap only when oversized), `content_hash` dedup with Drive `fileId` as canonical identity, Postgres full-text search (`tsvector`+GIN) for retrieval — free, built into Supabase, sufficient at a low-hundreds-of-document corpus. Query surface mirrors this fleet's own three-tier boot doctrine exactly: `ray_doc_index` (lightweight, index-only) for cheap default loads, `get_ray_document(id)` / `search_ray(query)` RPCs for full content on demand. pgvector is an explicit, non-blocking Phase-2 lever if paraphrase recall proves insufficient; Arabic FTS quality is a known MVP gap (no native Postgres "arabic" config — falls back to `simple` + `pg_trgm`). **This layer is PII-clean by construction** (course-knowledge content only, PII-shaped material excluded at classify time) — it needs its own named silo per TENANT-RESIDENCY-001, but not a UAE-region lock. That lock is reserved for the T2 tier below (§3).

**The agent** (`agent_id='ray-ca'` — deliberately not `cc-`-prefixed, not a `cosem-*` sub-tag; a skill-executor/persona like `cai`, not a tmux coding lane) is a fresh, headless `claude -p` call per message, `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN`-authenticated (Max plan, `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` explicitly unset — same pattern `lanes.sh`/`launch_dangerous_cc.sh` already use), `cwd` hard-scoped to `~/.wingmen/cosem-ca-corpus/`. It is filesystem-incapable of reaching the cosem-adcda codebase or any other client's files even under a bad prompt. Skills live as real Claude Code Skills under `~/.wingmen/cosem-ca-corpus/.claude/skills/`, promoting Syed's own existing persona file into the engine's system prompt rather than rewriting it. Boundaries are code, not promise — `nervous_system/ray_ca/boundaries.py` mirrors `fleet_health_boundaries.py`'s `assert_*`/`BoundaryViolation`/`self_test()` shape: folder-path allowlist, PII-shape detector (blocks and quarantines, including a chat paste), draft-only gate on every external-facing send, ops-only gate (never writes `strategic_decisions`/grants), and a disarmed Military-ID-reconciliation code path.

**The bot** is one new BotFather bot (proposed `@cosem_ray_bot`, exact handle TBD with Syed/Musa — confirm no collision at registration time), token `RAY_BOT_TOKEN`, wired through the fleet's **existing** `nervous_system/ingest.py`/`tg_out.py` daemons via a new `bot_channels` row (`channel_key='ray-ca'`, `mode='ai-responder'`, `responder_ref='ray_ca'`, deny-by-default `allowed_chat_ids` = Syed's captured chat_id, widened to include Musa once real data is in play). It is issued **no credential for the hub's `@wingmennorchbot` channel** — the same token+channel separation (CAI-RESP-389) that keeps Nazim's console body out of the hub's pen, applied to a third body. Escalation is exclusively an attributable `agent_messages` bus row to `cc-orchestrator` — Ray-ca cannot message the operator directly, and rides the existing `priority_sla_watchdog.py` by severity. Zero new paging infrastructure.

**Course-admin actions — orchestrate, don't duplicate.** The production PWA (`cosem-adcda-cb6d9` Firestore) already owns namelist, digital-native exams, and printables authoritatively; Ray-ca reads/summarizes/QAs these via chat, never re-derives them. v1 stays Drive-ingest- and read-query-based — it does **not** hard-integrate with cosem-adcda's Firebase or the in-flight `cosem-platform` Supabase re-platform (its GitHub remote and Supabase project are both still `TBD` as of today's `REPOS.json` — confirmed fresh, not stale). More importantly: **`pipelines/adcda-bot/` already exists** — I confirmed it live: the branch `feat/adcda-bapt-grading-engine` is checked out right now in the local `cosem-adcda` worktree, 15+ commits, last one 2026-07-01, a tested (36/36) Node engine that turns a photo of a paper scoresheet into an OCR → table-reconstruct → roster-match → Sheets+Firestore upsert, with a registry/adapter pattern already covering BAPT physical test, theory FF1+hazmat, and FF-practical NFPA unit-competency. **This is real, proven engineering — reuse it, don't rebuild it.** It has its own bot skeleton and its own `ADCDA_BOT_TOKEN`; that does **not** become Ray-ca's interaction surface. Syed gets one bot: a text message routes to a ray-ca chat skill, a photo of a scoresheet routes to adcda-bot's engine invoked as a backend library. One front door for Syed, same principle the fleet is already applying operator-side. adcda-bot itself is blocked on four Syed-supplied inputs (real sample PDFs per assessment type, bot-token handoff, target Sheet ID, real column layout) — a coordination task, not an engineering one; sequence it in parallel, not blocking, since further engineering on an unvalidated column-format guess compounds risk.

Concrete v1 action set, in build order once the MVP proves itself (detail in §4/§5): (1) namelist/roster query + drift detection, read-only; (2) printables orchestration + an automated exact-N QA gate (this also catches a *known* existing bug class — `functions/lib/reportCleanup.js` blanks leftover `{{token}}` text but doesn't delete the resulting empty row/shape); (3) exam-admin query + retest-eligibility assistant, reusing the existing pure functions in `skillSheetScoring.js` (no-same-day rule, 3-attempt cap) rather than reimplementing them; (4) bilingual (EN/AR) participant comms drafts, draft-only — Syed sends by hand, a bot confirmation flips Ray-ca's tracking state; (5) reporting digests + appraisal drafts requiring human sign-off (closes ADCDA's own still-open requirements-backlog item 6).

---

## 3. The governance gate

### 3.1 The PII taxonomy (name it, don't leave it vague)

| Tier | What's in it | Example fields |
|---|---|---|
| **T0** — non-personal | schedules, templates, curriculum, aggregate counts, published policy | — |
| **T1** — staff/operational PII | identifiable people, not gov-ID-linked | staff/trainer names, roles, UAE mobile numbers |
| **T2** — gov-ID / biometric (**the gate**) | Ray-ca's actual core value surface (Military-ID reconciliation) is fundamentally T2 — this is central, not a corner case | `militaryId` (3-digit group register), `actualMilitaryId` (future 6-digit), `emiratesId` (784-XXXX-XXXXXXX-X), DOB tied to identity, headshot/`faceDescriptor`, signatures, any per-trainee score/result keyed to name+ID |

### 3.2 How the prototype stays provably clean (synthetic-only)

Cleanliness is proven by running code, not asserted from memory:

- **Verified allowlist, not trusted access-scope** — `RAY_ALLOWED_DRIVE_FOLDER_IDS` walked against every file's real parent chain (§2).
- **`scripts/lib/pii_classifier.py`** — regex/pattern match on Emirates-ID format, military-ID-near-a-name-column, filename patterns (`namelist`, `military`, `results`, `bapt`, `eid`). Runs **pre-persistence AND pre-prompt** — a hit is quarantine, not silent pass-through, including something Syed pastes into chat by accident.
- **`scripts/assert_prototype_pii_clean.py`** — a fail-closed, pure-predicate scanner (same shape as `fleet_health_boundaries.py` / `require_verified_authorization.py`: predicate + CLI + `self_test()`) that refuses to let a demo/prototype session start on any T2 hit anywhere in Ray-ca's store or local corpus dirs.
- **Synthetic data reuses existing, proven convention** — `cosem-adcda/scripts/generate-mock-trainees.mjs` (Arabic name pool, seeded fixtures) extended to emit Military-ID/Emirates-ID-**shaped-but-invalid** values, batch label suffixed `-DEMO` and offset from the real one (e.g. "ADCDA 17/18-DEMO" vs. real "18/19"), synthetic tenant name **"Meridian Training Academy"** (reusing the placeholder already established for CAI-RESP-427). Don't invent a new fixture generator.
- **LLM-prompt minimization** — even in production, IDs are opaque join-keys the code matches; only derived outputs (names, counts, discrepancy flags) go into what the LLM drafts. Storage residency and prompt-leakage are two different channels — a compliant silo doesn't make PII-in-prompt safe by itself.

### 3.3 What MUST be true before real T2 data — the production gate

**Reconciled silo architecture** (the two source designs disagreed here; this is the resolution): the PII-clean knowledge layer (§2) gets its own light, named silo now — no UAE lock needed, just provisioned + entered in `docs/data-store-registry.md` before first real (non-synthetic) write, per TENANT-RESIDENCY-001's letter even though the content is PII-clean. The **T2 tier** (Military-ID reconciliation, Rung 4) is a different, heavier bar: it shares **one** cai-verified **UAE-region** Supabase project with the already-mandated Dir Adel/`cosem-platform` silo (CAI-RESP-427) — as its own schema, its own scoped service-role credential, never a second UAE project and never a shared unscoped key. This needs a joint cai+operator decision; `cosem-platform`'s own Supabase project is confirmed **still TBD** as of today.

- **Region precision matters**: target **AWS `me-central-1`** (literal UAE, Abu Dhabi — Supabase runs on AWS). Google Cloud's `me-central1` is Doha, Qatar — a different cloud, near-identical name, and is what cosem-adcda's *existing* Firestore already uses for this UAE client, apparently without an on-record ruling. Flagged upward, not Ray-ca's to fix, but don't repeat the substitution in the new silo.
- **`scripts/lib/residency_gate.py`** (mirrors `require_verified_authorization.py`'s fail-closed shape) gates **every T2 read AND write** — a Director-brief query that pulls a real Military ID is a T2 touch too, not just persistence — against a new `silo_registry` table requiring `tenant='adcda'`, region resolved to UAE (or a documented cai-approved alternative), and `cai_verified_at IS NOT NULL`.
- **PDPL, not PDPA** — the governing law is **UAE Federal Decree-Law No. 45 of 2021 (PDPL)**, confirmed directly from ADCDA's own `EID_Data_Policy.docx` already sitting in the corpus. (This is a different law from the Singapore PDPA used elsewhere in this fleet for Irsyad — don't conflate them.) Controls are **inherited from that document, not invented fresh**: retention (Section 10.2 — currently **undecided**, pending ADCDA's own Head of Training Academy, an external dependency the fleet can't close unilaterally), access (deny-by-default + offboarding on **all** separation types — the policy itself names "offboarding limited to dismissals" as its own open gap; don't repeat it), audit (field-name-only logging, never the raw ID value, independently reviewed), consent/purpose-limitation (confirm the trainees' original onboarding consent covers "AI course-administrator reconciliation/reporting" — likely a one-line addition, not a new flow), incident response (a `residency_gate.py` denial pages the operator loudly, not a silent log line).

**Pre-live checklist** — every box closed, jointly signed by cai + operator, before one real T2 row is written:

| # | Condition |
|---|---|
| 1 | UAE-region (or documented cai-approved alt) Supabase project named in `docs/data-store-registry.md` + `cai_verified_at` set in `silo_registry` |
| 2 | Tenant-sharing-with-Dir-Adel decision explicitly closed (shared silo vs. standalone) |
| 3 | Schema-level isolation + own scoped service-role credential inside the silo |
| 4 | `residency_gate.py` wired into every T2 read/write path, unit-tested fail-closed |
| 5 | Consent/purpose-limitation line confirmed present at the T2 data's origin |
| 6 | Retention period ADCDA-confirmed + auto-purge scheduled, not manual |
| 7 | Access allowlist deny-by-default + full-separation-type offboarding live |
| 8 | Access-audit logging live, field-name-only, independently reviewed |
| 9 | Production PII-clean scan (`assert_prototype_pii_clean.py`-equivalent) proves no T2 data exists outside the verified silo |
| 10 | Operator's infra go-ahead + cai's compliance sign-off — both, per TENANT-RESIDENCY-001's "joint grant" |

**Until every box is checked, Ray-ca's single most-requested capability — Military-ID reconciliation — stays demo-only against synthetic discrepancies. Never the real, currently-open Group-1/4 discrepancy.**

---

## 4. MVP — the smallest demo-able slice that makes Syed say yes

Not a features list — a falsifiable test. Ray-ca's real-data output has to match what Syed already knows to be true, has to admit what it can't resolve instead of guessing, and has to never touch his authoritative files uninvited (all three are Syed's own documented standards — he already caught one AI-adjacent data bug and holds Claude to "brutally honest, push back"). The gate is binary: **does he skip his own manual Sunday regen next week and ship Ray-ca's output instead?**

| When | Ships | Governance stance | Exit signal |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Day 0** | §0 remediation | — | quarantine + gitignore done |
| **Day 0–1** | New bot live through existing `ingest.py`/`tg_out.py`; AR↔EN translation on request; Syed does a live `/start` (this bot cannot DM him first — same gotcha as `@nazim_cto_bot`, don't skip it) | none — zero data model, zero PII surface | Syed forwards one real message and gets a translation back |
| **Day 1–4 — Rung 0** | Synthetic demo: clone the Firestore schema shape (`trainees`, `attendanceSessions`, `skillSheets`, `theoryResults`) into a "Meridian Training Academy" seed with a **planted** G1/G4-style ID mismatch; build the Director one-pager + drift-flag skill; demo **live** to Syed | none — 100% synthetic | Ray-ca surfaces the planted discrepancy **without being told about it** |
| **Day 4–7 — Rung 1** | Cutover to real cosem-adcda Firestore + this week's schedule xlsx from Drive, **aggregate/non-PII fields only** (`status`, `%`, counts, dates — `militaryId`/`emiratesId`/`arName`/`enName`/`dob`/`phone`/`faceDescriptor`/`idFrontUrl`/`headshotUrl`/`signatureUrl` denylisted at the **query layer**, not just output); real Director one-pager, **shadow mode** — Musa QA's the first 1–2 cycles before Syed sees them; zero writes anywhere | light knowledge-silo naming only (§3.3) — no cai gate needed, this posture mirrors what an earlier session's masked Firestore mapping already did safely | Musa signs off the shadow output as correct |
| **Week 2+** | Widen to the 3 weekly xlsx matrices + monthly Observations deck (same read layer, more templates, no new plumbing) once the exit test passes | same | "yes, skip Sunday's manual regen" |

**Explicitly out of MVP** (protects this from scope creep): Military-ID reconciliation (needs the Rung-4 residency gate), trainee onboarding/EID capture (already owned by the cosem-adcda app), autonomous sending of anything external-facing, schedule generation/optimization (Ray-ca reports on the schedule, doesn't write it), adcda-bot's real-PDF cutover (separate, Syed-blocked track — run in parallel, don't gate the MVP on it).

---

## 5. Path-to-paid

**Timing reframe.** Batch 18/19 graduates 2026-08-20 — 29 days from today. That's real runway for a live, high-stakes pilot (BAPT 4, theory re-sits, PT Part 2, and graduation reporting all fall inside this window), but it's the wrong target for a *paid* contract given how little of the course is left. Run it free, time-boxed to graduation. The stronger, better-evidenced pitch is one Syed already wrote himself: his own "ADCDA NFPA 1010 Course Conduct Reference" states its purpose is so "a new Course Administrator — human or AI — could run Batch 20/21," and separately names the exact gap Ray-ca targets ("the funnel was never reconciled in one place. For Batch 20/21, fix the authoritative headcount definition on day one"). **Position the paid engagement to start at Batch 20's kickoff** — "Batch 20 starts with one source of truth from day one" — not "let me help you finish this month."

**Buyer.** COSEM is the account; Syed is the user and channel owner, not necessarily the budget approver. Identify who at COSEM actually signs off before a number gets discussed.

**Pricing — mechanism, not a fabricated number.** No COSEM price precedent exists anywhere in the fleet's records.

| Option | Shape | Recommendation |
|---|---|---|
| A — retainer bundle | Fold into a renewed/expanded COSEM software retainer alongside cosem-adcda maintenance + the specced `cosem-video-pipeline` | **Lead with this** — reuses an existing budget line, lowest procurement friction |
| B — per-seat subscription | Monthly, per course-administrator seat | Evolve to this once 2+ seats are live (Al Ain 2 — already running in the same Firestore project — is a near-zero-marginal-cost second seat, if Musa can confirm who administers it) |
| C — per-cycle fee | Timed to a ~17-week batch | Fallback if A/B don't land |

Bring these three to COSEM **this week**, in parallel with the free pilot — that's how "payment before proceed" gets honored without blocking the proof itself.

**The single biggest risk to the deal: trust is fragile and asymmetric, and the first real number is the whole ballgame.** Syed already caught one AI-adjacent data bug — the hand-copied xlsx that fed the Group-1/4 discrepancy — and holds every AI output to "brutally honest, don't just agree." One wrong number in the very first real-data output (the Rung-1 shadow-mode one-pager, §4) can permanently poison adoption before the paid conversation ever starts, because it would confirm his priors about AI reliability rather than counter them. The mitigation isn't a separate control — it's already load-bearing in the MVP sequence: synthetic-first validation (Rung 0), then Musa's own QA gating the first 1–2 real cycles before Syed ever sees them (Rung 1). Do not compress or skip that shadow window to move faster.

Secondary risks worth one line each: a build slip past the pilot window loses the graduation-reporting proving ground and the natural segue into Batch 20; the pull to build the full 10-category CA platform before the "replaces Sunday's regen" gate passes is real and should be resisted; Syed's actual day-to-day likely runs more on WhatsApp/Drive than Telegram, so the bot needs an explicit onboarding moment, not just a link (mirrors the fleet's own "Nazim channel needs operator /start" lesson).

---

## 6. First 3 concrete build steps

*(§0's remediation isn't counted here — it's a 10-minute fix, do it first, but it isn't "build." adcda-bot's blocker-closing with Syed also runs in parallel, not as one of these three — it's coordination, not engineering, and shouldn't gate Ray-ca's own path.)*

**1. Stand up identity + bot (same day).** Register `agents` row `agent_id='ray-ca'` (confirm no collision first). BotFather-create the bot (proposed `@cosem_ray_bot`), drop `RAY_BOT_TOKEN` into `.env`. New `bot_channels` row: `channel_key='ray-ca'`, `mode='ai-responder'`, `responder_ref='ray_ca'`, `enabled=false` until the walkthrough. Get Syed to `/start` it once live. Ship the AR↔EN translation quick-win — near-zero build since it reuses the existing `ingest.py`/`tg_out.py` daemons end to end. *Owner: fleet build + one message to Syed.
